parameters.lemmatization: Simplemma English, greedy=False; alphabetic tokens only

explanation.score: (group document frequency / readable group papers) * log((readable corpus papers + 1) / (corpus document frequency + 1)); bigrams get a 1.2 multiplier
explanation.terms: Unigrams/bigrams are lemmatized before counting and ranking. term is an observed display form; lemma and variants record the grouping. Each paper counts once per lemma.
explanation.ranking: score times bootstrap top-keyword selection rate; suppress nested unigram/bigram duplicates
explanation.stability: selection_rate measures recurrence under within-folder paper resampling, not topic probability, correctness, or semantic coherence
explanation.identity: SHA-256 of PDF bytes; identical copies count once per folder and corpus; different versions are not merged
explanation.hierarchy: Each parent includes descendant PDFs plus its direct PDFs; rows overlap and percentages must not be summed
explanation.text: Bounded PDF abstract; otherwise front matter before ACM metadata when detectable, otherwise first pages. Normalize Unicode ligatures and line-break hyphenation. No filenames, folder names, DB labels, OCR, or network in keyword input
